summary: ABC Riverina is an ABC Local Radio station based in Wagga Wagga, New South Wales. It broadcasts to the Riverina and Murrumbidgee Irrigation Area regions. Its coverage includes the towns and cities of Griffith, Goulburn, Leeton and Hay.
one_line: ABC Riverina is an ABC Local Radio station based in Wagga Wagga serving the Riverina and Murrumbidgee Irrigation Area in New South Wales.
key_facts: ABC Riverina is an ABC Local Radio station.
ABC Riverina is based in Wagga Wagga.
ABC Riverina broadcasts to the Riverina region in New South Wales.
ABC Riverina broadcasts to the Murrumbidgee Irrigation Area in New South Wales.
The station's broadcast area includes the towns and cities of Griffith, Goulburn, Leeton and Hay.
